newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares ease, weighed down by OMV.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares ease, weighed down by OMV.

text.p: Austrian shares closed flat on Wednesday after reaching an intraday high of 1,183.14, and traders said they expected further consolidation over the next few days.
The ATX index edged off 0.07 points or 0.01 percent to 1,172.87. Among its constituents six shares rose, 13 fell and two remained unchanged.
"Everything was a bit uncertain because of the United States," said one trader, referring to five consecutive days of losses on Wall Street.
"Investors are waiting for the market to calm down," another said.
The market came under pressure from regional electricity company EVN, Creditanstalt bank and especially from market heavy-weight oil and chemicals group OMV.
"When the sell order on OMV is completed, the market could begin to go back up again," one dealer said.
Traders said the index was well- supported at 1,170. The next target is seen around 1,200 points ahead of the expiry of the February future contract.
Motorcycle maker KTM led the gainers, climbing 3.93 pct to 688 schillings.
The top decliner was OMV, shedding 1.51 percent to 1,300 schillings.
The February ATX future eased 1.5 points to 1,178.5.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index added 0.03 points or 0.01 percent at 438.64
